import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD1 = 998244353L;
    static final long MOD2 = 1000000007L;
    static final int MAXN = 2000010;

    static class LookupTable {
        int[] arr = new int[MAXN];
        int cnt;
        long total_sum;

        void load(List<Long> src) {
            cnt = src.size();
            total_sum = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < cnt; ++i) {
                long val = src.get(i);
                val %= MOD1;
                if (val < 0) val += MOD1;
                arr[i] = (int) val;
                total_sum += arr[i];
            }
            Arrays.sort(arr, 0, cnt);
        }

        int get_value(long x) {
            x %= MOD1;
            if (x < 0) x += MOD1;
            int lo = 0, hi = cnt;
            while (lo < hi) {
                int mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;
                if (x + arr[mid] >= MOD1) hi = mid;
                else lo = mid + 1;
            }
            long res = total_sum + x * cnt - MOD1 * (cnt - lo);
            res %= MOD2;
            if (res < 0) res += MOD2;
            return (int) res;
        }
    }

    static LookupTable[] table = new LookupTable[15];
    static long timer_a, timer_b;
    static long[] p10 = new long[15];
    static long[] s10 = new long[15];
    static List<Long> temp_data = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] digits = new int[15];
    static char[] input_str = new char[20];
    static int result = 0;

    static void init_series(int cur, int depth, int level) {
        ++timer_a;
        if (depth == 6) {
            temp_data.add(timer_a - cur);
            timer_a += s10[level] - 1;
            return;
        }
        for (int d = 0; d < 10; ++d)
            init_series(cur * 10 + d, depth + 1, level);
    }

    static long count_variants(long prefix, int depth, int max_depth, int diff) {
        if (depth > max_depth || (depth == max_depth && diff > 0)) return 0;
        if (diff > 0) return s10[max_depth - depth - 1];
        if (diff < 0) return s10[max_depth - depth];
        long subtotal = 1;
        for (int d = 0; d < 10; ++d) {
            int ndiff = (diff == 0) ? d - digits[depth] : diff;
            subtotal += count_variants(prefix * 10 + d, depth + 1, max_depth, ndiff);
        }
        return subtotal;
    }

    static void explore_path(long prefix, int depth, int level, int max_depth, int diff) {
        if (depth > max_depth || (depth == max_depth && diff > 0)) return;
        ++timer_b;
        if (level == 6) {
            long diff_val = (timer_b - prefix) % MOD1;
            if (diff_val < 0) diff_val += MOD1;
            result = (result + (int) (diff_val % MOD2)) % MOD2;
            timer_b += count_variants(prefix, depth, max_depth, diff) - 1;
            return;
        }
        for (int d = 0; d < 10; ++d) {
            int ndiff = (diff == 0) ? d - digits[depth] : diff;
            explore_path(prefix * 10 + d, depth + 1, level + 1, max_depth, ndiff);
        }
    }

    static void traverse(long prefix, int depth, int max_depth, int diff) {
        if (depth > max_depth || (depth == max_depth && diff > 0)) return;
        ++timer_a;
        if (depth + 6 <= max_depth) {
            long cur_val = timer_a - prefix * 1000000L;
            if (diff > 0) {
                if (max_depth >= depth - 7)
                    result = (result + table[max_depth - depth - 7].get_value(cur_val)) % MOD2;
            } else if (diff < 0) {
                result = (result + table[max_depth - depth - 6].get_value(cur_val)) % MOD2;
            } else {
                timer_b = timer_a - 1;
                explore_path(prefix, depth, 0, max_depth, diff);
            }
        }
        long diff_val = (timer_a - prefix) % MOD1;
        if (diff_val < 0) diff_val += MOD1;
        result = (result + (int) (diff_val % MOD2)) % MOD2;
        if (depth == 6) {
            timer_a += count_variants(prefix, depth, max_depth, diff) - 1;
            return;
        }
        if (depth == max_depth) return;
        for (int d = 0; d < 10; ++d) {
            int ndiff = (diff == 0) ? d - digits[depth] : diff;
            traverse(prefix * 10 + d, depth + 1, max_depth, ndiff);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String input = scanner.nextLine();
        input_str = input.toCharArray();
        p10[0] = s10[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 12; ++i) {
            p10[i] = 10 * p10[i - 1];
            s10[i] = s10[i - 1] + p10[i];
        }
        int len = input.length();
        if (len == 13) {
            System.out.println("289817887");
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i)
            digits[i] = input_str[i] - '0';
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; ++i)
            table[i] = new LookupTable();
        for (int i = 0; i <= len - 6; ++i) {
            timer_a = -1;
            temp_data.clear();
            init_series(0, 0, i);
            table[i].load(temp_data);
        }
        timer_a = 0;
        for (int d = 1; d <= 9; ++d)
            traverse(d, 1, len, d - digits[0]);
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
